name: shattered facets assemble into a framed print held by hand
looks: A dark, cracked facet pattern sits on the wall where a print should be, each shard a sliver of the image showing through. The shards snap together into the whole framed print, and a pair of hands reaches in to hold it level against the wall, leaf-shadow drifting behind it.
build: The frame's surface is divided into irregular facet shapes that fade/scale to 0 opacity in a seeded order, revealing the full print underneath, same family as wireframe-to-facet-reveal's face-fill; the hands are a filmed or rendered overlay that enters once the print has resolved.
sound: A soft glassy tick per facet resolving, a gentle rustle as the hands settle the frame.
prompt: Show a dark, faceted crack pattern on a wall resolving shard by shard into a complete framed image, then have a pair of hands reach in to hold the finished print level against the wall, with a soft leaf-shadow drifting behind it, to turn the digital output tangible.
